# Send Studio

> Email CRM with block template editor, multi-channel campaigns, and Resend analytics.

Send Studio is a Next.js application for managing contacts, designing email templates with drag-and-drop blocks and Liquid, sending campaigns via Resend / WhatsApp / Telegram, and tracking delivery events.

## Public pages

- `/` — Dashboard
- `/contacts` — Contact CRM and CSV import
- `/templates` — Template library
- `/templates/generate` — AI template generation
- `/campaigns` — Campaign sending
- `/analytics` — Email event analytics

## Tech

- Next.js App Router, React, Tailwind CSS
- Turso (SQLite), Resend API, Liquid templates

## Contact

Configure `SITE_URL` for your deployment domain.
